metadata.title: Semantic Presence Stabilization & Adaptive Character Guide Foundation
metadata.visual_reviewer: Antigravity AI (Gemini Vision Direct Empirical Inspection)

Cond01.name: Legacy Base (two students) Alice L / Bob R (Hyper12, seed 42)

observed.artifacts: Vertical banner with pseudo-kanji text between blank purple rectangular shutters
observed.visual_description: Legacy base prompt conflicts with regional characters; neither Alice nor Bob manifest; 0/2 subjects.

Cond01.finding: Base prompt describing 'two students standing' causes identity confusion and text hallucination.

Cond02.name: Background-Only Base Alice L / Bob R (WF48, Hyper12, seed 42)

observed.artifacts: Two sliding architectural shutters with vertical handles
observed.visual_description: Clean perspective courtyard. Pseudo-text eliminated, but base ControlNet box guides are interpreted as large sliding shutters.

Cond02.finding: Background-only base prompt cleanly isolates environment from characters, eliminating pseudo-text.

Cond03.name: Alice Left Only Hyper12 (WF49, seed 42)

observed.displacement: Displaced from target left [0.10] to center-right corridor [0.54]
observed.visual_description: Left target region rendered as opaque wall panel; female student walks in open right alleyway.

Cond03.finding: Without regional ControlNet guidance, character escapes box constraint into unconstrained open space.

Cond04.name: Alice Right Only Hyper12 (WF50, seed 42)

observed.artifacts: Right box rendered as blank shutter with faint top lettering
observed.visual_description: Right box completely suppressed into architectural shutter; no student manifested.

Cond04.finding: Right-hand single character exhibits higher suppression under seed 42 courtyard geometry.

Cond05.name: Bob Left Only Hyper12 (WF51, seed 42)

observed.displacement: Displaced from target left [0.10] to center-right corridor [0.54]
observed.visual_description: Left target region rendered as opaque wall panel; student manifested in alleyway.

Cond05.finding: Matches Alice Left behavior; spatial displacement is position-dependent rather than character-dependent.

Cond06.name: Bob Right Only Hyper12 (WF52, seed 42)

observed.artifacts: Right box rendered as blank shutter
observed.visual_description: Right box suppressed into architectural shutter.

Cond06.finding: Mirrors Alice Right failure; right-side box acts as architectural occlusion in this perspective.

Cond07.name: Two-Character Swap C2: Bob L / Alice R (Hyper12, seed 42, CN off)

observed.visual_description: Identical twin sliding shutters to Cond02.

Cond07.finding: Both swap directions fail identically under base-only CN, proving failure is due to guide architecture interpretation, not character swap direction.

Cond08.name: Region Order Sanity: Bob then Alice attending order (Hyper12, seed 42)
Cond08.finding: REGION_ORDER_EFFECT is strictly NONE. Execution order of regional prompts has zero impact on spatial binding.

Cond09.name: PRH-v1: BBox Outline ON (Bob L / Alice R, Hyper12, seed 42)

observed.artifacts: Two shutter panels with barred windows; vertical kanji text on pillar
observed.visual_description: Bounding box outline causes ControlNet to hallucinate window bars and doorframes.

Cond09.finding: PER-REGION BBOX OUTLINE is HARMFUL; must be removed.

Cond10.name: PRH-v2: Clean Hint No-Box Bob L / Alice R (WF53, Hyper12, seed 42)

observed.other_subjects: Silhouette figure entering doorway at bottom center [0.48, 0.67, 0.04, 0.21]
observed.artifacts: Clean grey panels without barred windows; doorframe hallucination eliminated
observed.visual_description: Clean silhouette guide eliminates barred window hallucination; human form emerges at doorway.

Cond10.finding: PER-REGION HINT V2 (no-box) successfully eliminates window/doorframe artifacts.

Cond11.name: PRH-v2: Clean Hint No-Box Alice L / Bob R (Hyper12, seed 42)

observed.visual_description: Identical clean panel rendering with doorway silhouette figure as Cond10.

Cond11.finding: Confirms PRH-v2 behavior is symmetrical across character swap.

Cond12.name: Seed Robustness: Seed 43 Bob L / Alice R PRH v2 (Hyper12, seed 43)

observed.visual_description: Traditional school entrance facade with clean symmetrical courtyard and flanking walls. Zero wireframe or distortion artifacts.

Cond12.finding: Seed 43 demonstrates stable architectural generation under Hyper12 + PRH v2.

Cond13.name: Adaptive Shot Type: Alice Half Body (Hyper12, seed 42, PRH v2)

observed.visual_description: Clean waist-up framing; upper courtyard arch and circular skylight; lower 40% clean open floor.

Cond13.finding: SHOT TYPE HALF BODY successfully adapts guide density and clears lower staging area.

Cond14.name: Adaptive Shot Type: Alice Bust Shot (Hyper12, seed 42, PRH v2)

observed.visual_description: Clean chest-up framing; focus concentrated on upper circular window and portal; lower 55% clean floor.

Cond14.finding: SHOT TYPE BUST successfully contracts guide height to upper 45% of staging box.
